queries: "Mapping the Increasing Use of LLMs in Scientific Papers" arxiv

sources_considered.why: Primary retrospective measurement covering publications through February 2024. It measures AI modification, not defective content.
read_page marked the article PARTIAL. Its search-result count also would not establish a publication trend.
read_page could not retrieve the oversized PDF. The search-visible annual totals also did not isolate the period before March 15.

evidence_items.explanation: The study analyzes 950,965 papers through February 2024 and establishes increasing LLM modification. It does not measure whether the modified material was erroneous or carelessly incorporated.

unresolved_gaps: No retrieved, readable audit establishes a comparable early-2024 time series of validated defective AI-generated publications.
The available population estimate does not distinguish beneficial writing assistance from publication defects.
Discovery counts cannot establish when the underlying defective papers were published.
